summary: Reconstructed XDK-free import libraries for RB3Enhanced.dll from the STOCK 0.7 DLL's own XEX import table (ground truth) cross-checked against xorloser x360_imports.py. Only TWO host modules: xam.xex (44 imports) and xboxkrnl.exe (55 imports). Generated .def + .lib for both via the proven wibo link.exe /LIB recipe, and PROVED end-to-end by compiling an XDK-free TU that calls 5 imports and linking it into a valid PPCBE PE whose import table resolves to the exact ground-truth ordinals.

ground_truth_source.method: b (stock DLL import table) primary, a (x360_imports.py namegen) cross-check

key_findings: RB3Enhanced.dll imports from exactly TWO modules: xam.xex (44) + xboxkrnl.exe (55) = 99 symbols. No xnet.xex / xapilib.xex / xonline.xex import descriptors exist in the final image.

The XDK Makefile links xapilib.lib+xboxkrnl.lib+xnet.lib+xonline.lib, but ALL of xapilib/xnet/xonline forward to xam.xex at runtime -- so our two OSS libs (xam.lib->xam.xex, xboxkrnl.lib->xboxkrnl.exe) fully replace all four XDK import libs.
All Net*/XNet*/Upnp*/Xam* symbols come from xam.xex (NetDll_* are the socket layer at ords 1-27; XNet at 51-78; Upnp at 251-264; Xam at 420-714).

wibo LACKED GetTempPathW/GetTempFileNameW -- link.exe calls GetTempPathW whenever it builds a real import table (dlltest.dll never triggered it because dlltest.c calls no imports). This was the true blocker for ALL OSS import linking, not just this lane. Fixed by adding both W stubs to wibo (additive).

verification.result: PROVEN -- import descriptors present and ordinals exactly match ground truth

deliverables.xex1tool: tools/oss-xbox-build/L-importlibs/xex1tool (standalone idaxex build, reusable for import dumps)

wibo_change.change: Added GetTempPathW + GetTempFileNameW (thin wrappers over the existing A variants). Additive, uncommitted. Rebuilt build/release/wibo.
wibo_change.note: REQUIRED for any OSS import link. If wibo is rebuilt fresh elsewhere without this patch, import linking will abort with 'missing import GetTempPathW'.

residual_risks: verify_imports.dll is a PE, not yet packed to XEX -- boot-level validation belongs to the packer lane, not this one.

The full RB3E DLL will reference all 99 ordinals; verified 5 representative ones. The .defs contain the complete ground-truth set, so full coverage is by-construction but a full-DLL link is the packer/link lane's job.
ordinals are version-keyed; these are taken from the stock 0.7 DLL (v2.0.21256.0 target, min 1861) so they are version-correct for the exact artifact we are replacing.
